messages:
alex_r: Heads-up — customer CBG reported p99 spikes starting ~02:00 UTC. Dashboard shows KV prefix miss-rate went from 4% -> 45% and p99 from 220ms -> 1.2s. Escalating.

maria: seeing the same in telemetry. Key cardinality jumped for prefix 'cbg_session:'. Suspect warmup/eviction thrash.

samir: any recent rollout to cache eviction logic or TTL changes?

maria: not in prod today. Small CV in staging yesterday related to header-derived key hashing, but I rolled it back. Need logs.

support-jen: customer says their app sees slow responses and timeouts hitting our text-generation endpoint. They've escalated to their SRE.

alex_r: attaching quick query from metrics: 
```
kv_prefix_miss_rate{prefix="cbg_session"} 0.45
kv_prefix_p95_ms{prefix="cbg_session"} 720
kv_prefix_p99_ms{prefix="cbg_session"} 1220
```

kaushik: repro attempt locally — hit pattern looks like header-order variations + extra trace headers producing distinct cache keys. Example repro: 
```
for i in {1..500}; do
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" \
    -H "X-Client-ID: cbg" \
    -H "Traceparent: 00-$(openssl rand -hex 16)-$(openssl rand -hex 8)-01" \
    "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate?model=rw1" &
  sleep 0.01
done
```
Responses alternate fast/slow as KV warmup misses spike.

maria: looks like we still include some headers in cache key fingerprinting. There's a known normalization bug: headers listed in varying order produce different key strings before hashing — increases effective cardinality.

samir: can we quickly mitigate by disabling header-derived parts of the prefix key for cbg tenant?

maria: yes — we can flip tenant-scoped flag `prefix_key_strip_headers` to true for cbg. Doing a canary now on shard-7.

deploy-bot: deploy started: cfg/prefix-cache-toggle cbg shard-7 -> true by maria @ 3187660050

alex_r: any telemetry after the toggle?

maria: initial numbers: miss-rate dropped from 45% -> 9% over 3 minutes, p99 down to ~260ms. Still a bit higher than baseline but much better.

kaushik: patch ready that canonicalizes header ordering and strips trace headers before key construction. I pushed PR #2891 to staging.

support-jen: can we share temporary mitigation with customer? they want ETA.

alex_r: yes — tell them we've applied tenant-scoped cache key normalization toggle and performance improved. Full fix ETA: 8 hours to test + staged rollout.

maria: next steps: 1) merge header-canonicalize PR -> run canary on 3 shards, 2) add unit test for header permutations, 3) create alert for sudden cardinality jumps, 4) postmortem draft SR-3245. Assigning owners: kaushik -> fix, samir -> rollout, maria -> monitoring + postmortem.

samir: also recommend temporary increase of prefix cache LRU capacity on shard-7 by +15% to absorb residual churn while we rollout. I'll enact once we confirm no memory pressure.

kaushik: will add config flag and feature gate for safe rollback.

alex_r: thanks team. If numbers re-regress call page. I'll update the incident ticket INC-2026-045 with these mitigation steps and customer comms. :thumbsup:
